title: Boundaries are a form of care, not a punishment
intro: A grounded reflection on saying yes, saying no, and making room for honest connection.

sections.heading: Name the pattern
sections.body: Start with what repeats, not only what happened today.

sections.heading: Make the request clear
sections.body: A boundary is easier to hear when it describes what you will do next.

sections.heading: Watch the response
sections.body: Another person’s reaction gives you information, even when it is difficult.
